scheme_name: Karnataka Raitha Suraksha - Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
title: Karnataka Raitha Suraksha Crop Insurance Scheme
department: Department of Agriculture, Government of Karnataka, in coordination with the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India

scheme_details.description: A crop insurance programme implemented in Karnataka to provide financial protection to insured farmers against eligible crop losses caused by specified natural events, weather conditions and other covered risks.
eligibility: Farmers growing notified crops in notified insurance areas
Farmers meeting the applicable season-specific scheme guidelines
Landowners and eligible tenant or sharecropper cultivators, subject to applicable rules and documentation
farmer_category: Other eligible farmers cultivating notified crops

money_benefits.subsidy: Government shares the eligible crop insurance premium subsidy according to the applicable scheme guidelines.
money_benefits.direct_financial_assistance: Insurance claim payments for eligible and assessed crop losses, subject to policy terms.
money_benefits.insurance_support: Crop insurance for notified crops, areas and seasons against covered risks.

documents_required: Aadhaar or other accepted identity documentation
Cultivation or tenancy documentation where applicable
application_process: Check the notified crops, insurance unit, season, premium and enrolment deadline for the farmer's district.
Apply through the prescribed state portal, authorised channel or participating institution, as applicable.
Provide the requested identity, cultivation, land and bank details.
Pay the applicable farmer premium within the notified deadline.
Retain the application receipt and policy or enrolment reference.
Report crop loss through the prescribed channel within the applicable reporting period.
Track the claim through the official portal and respond to any verification requirements.
benefits: Financial protection against covered crop losses
Support against specified natural calamities and adverse weather events
Protection against eligible prevented sowing or planting risks
Coverage for eligible localised calamities and specified post-harvest losses
Reduced financial uncertainty for insured farmers
Claim tracking through the state crop-insurance system
scheme_details.implemented_by: Government of Karnataka and Government of India, through the designated implementing agencies and insurers
target_beneficiaries: Eligible farmers cultivating notified crops in Karnataka

data_source.notes: Crop eligibility, insurance premium rates, enrolment deadlines and coverage depend on the specific district, crop and season. Verify the current Karnataka notification before recording them as definitive.
